Definition
[Integral of a simple function] ↗ def:simple-function-banach-valued 1. appE:E.5-def-5\group Vector-Valued Integration

For a simple function $s(t)=\sum _{i=1}^m\chi _{E_i}(t)u_i$, define \[ (6)\qquad \int _0^T s(t)\, dt:=\sum _{i=1}^m|E_i|u_i. \]
